solutions.code: function solve({records,workspace}) { return records.filter(record => record.workspace === workspace).map(record => record.id); }
function solve({writers,items}) { return {database: writers > 1 ? 'postgres' : 'sqlite', count: new Set(items.filter(item => typeof item === 'string')).size}; }
function solve({agesDays}) { return {kept: agesDays.filter(age => age >= 0 && age <= 30), retentionDays: 30}; }
function solve({ids}) { return [...new Set(ids.filter(id => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0))].map(id => ({id, engine: 'whisper', destination: 'local'})); }

function solve({method,status,attempt}) { const retry = method === 'GET' && (status === 429 || (status >= 500 && status <= 599)) && attempt < 3; return {retry, delayMs: retry ? 100 * 2 ** (attempt - 1) : 0}; }
function solve({events}) { return events.filter(event => event !== null && typeof event === 'object' && typeof event.id === 'string').map(event => ({id: event.id, type: event.type ?? 'unknown'})); }

function solve({amounts}) { let total = 0; for (const amount of amounts) { const [whole, fraction = ''] = amount.split('.'); total += Number(whole) * 100 + Number(fraction.padEnd(2, '0')); } return {total, unit: 'cents'}; }
